articles.summary: Aptiv supporting the Jetson ecosystem with production-ready sensing, perception, compute integration and lifecycle support for drones, robotics, industrial automation and other intelligent edge applications Collaboration expands Aptiv’s work with NVIDIA across Jetson platforms to include Jetson Orin Nano 2 Aptiv PLC (NYSE: APTV), a global industrial technology leader, today announced it is supporting NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 2, to help customers accelerate the deployment of production-ready physical AI and intelligent edge systems. The announcement builds on prior collaboration to support commercially deployable edge AI platforms based on NVIDIA Jetson, including Jetson Thor .
